examples.ko: 이 국물은 감칠맛이 나서 자꾸 생각나요.
examples.en: This broth has such a savory depth that I keep thinking about it.

examples.ko: 다시마를 넣으면 감칠맛을 더할 수 있어요.
examples.en: Adding kelp can give it more savory flavor.

examples.ko: 더덕구이가 감칠맛 있어서 밥 한 공기를 다 비웠어요.
examples.en: The grilled deodeok was so savory that I finished a whole bowl of rice.
It has a rich taste, but it's too salty.

examples.ko: 그 집 찌개의 감칠맛에 반해서 또 주문했어요.
examples.en: I fell for the savory taste of that place's stew and ordered again.
The savory taste is good and the aroma is good too.

explain: '맛있다'와 달리 입에 착 붙고 자꾸 당기는 깊은 맛을 말해요. 단맛, 짠맛, 신맛, 쓴맛과 함께 기본 맛으로 꼽는 맛(우마미)이고, 다시마나 멸치 육수, 버섯, 고기처럼 깊게 우러나는 맛에 많이 써요. 보통 '감칠맛이 나다', '감칠맛이 있다'로 말해요.
explain_en: Unlike plain '맛있다', it describes a deep, savory taste that makes you want more. It is counted as a basic taste alongside sweet, salty, sour and bitter (umami), and is often used for flavor from kelp or anchovy broth, mushrooms and meat. It is usually said as '감칠맛이 나다' or '감칠맛이 있다'.

examples.ko: 맛있어 보여서 먹었는데 개살구라서 너무 시어요.
examples.en: It looked tasty, but it was a wild apricot, so it's really sour.

examples.ko: 개살구는 보기에는 예쁘지만 맛이 시고 떫어요.
examples.en: Wild apricots look pretty, but they taste sour and astringent.

examples.ko: 어릴 때 친구들과 산에서 개살구를 따 먹었어요.
examples.en: When I was little, I picked and ate wild apricots in the mountains with my friends.

examples.ko: 산길에 개살구 나무가 있어서 열매를 구경했어요.
examples.en: There was a wild apricot tree on the mountain path, so I looked at its fruit.
It's hard to make jam out of wild apricots.
I bought it thinking it was an apricot, but it was a wild apricot.

explain: 살구 앞에 '개-'가 붙어서, 야생에서 자라 맛이 시고 떫은 살구를 가리켜요. '빛 좋은 개살구'라는 표현에 들어가는 말로도 알려져 있어요.

phrases.example: 광고만 보고 갔는데 빛 좋은 개살구였어요.
phrases.en: I went just because of the ad, but it was all show and no substance.
phrases.nuance_ko: 겉모양은 좋아 보이는데 속은 별로일 때 써요. 사람, 물건, 가게 모두에 쓸 수 있어요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something looks good outside but is disappointing inside. It can describe people, things or shops.
phrases.en_equiv: all that glitters is not gold

explain_en: With '개-' in front of 살구 (apricot), it refers to a wild apricot that tastes sour and astringent. It is also the word inside the expression '빛 좋은 개살구'.

examples.en: This meat is domestic, so I eat it with confidence.
Domestic fruit is more expensive than imported fruit.
At the mart, I only pick domestically grown beans.
The label says it is domestic.
Domestic and imported products taste very different.
This is kimchi made only with domestic ingredients.

explain: 주로 식재료나 농산물이 우리나라에서 나거나 만들어졌다는 뜻으로 마트 표시에 많이 나와요. 반대말은 '수입산'이에요. 공장 제품에는 '국산'이 더 자연스러워요.
explain_en: It is common on supermarket labels to say that food or produce comes from Korea. The opposite is '수입산'. For factory-made goods, '국산' sounds more natural.

en: being wild; being taken from nature

examples.en: This raw fish restaurant sells only wild fish.
Wild pine mushrooms are expensive.
Is this fish farmed or wild?

examples.ko: 자연산이라서 맛이 더 좋은 것 같아요.
examples.en: Because it is wild, it seems to taste better.
I tried wild sea bream for the first time.
There is a big price difference between wild and farmed.

explain: 반대말은 물고기라면 '양식', 채소나 버섯이라면 '재배'예요. 식당에서 생선, 버섯, 나물을 말할 때 자주 써요.
explain_en: The opposite is '양식' for fish, and '재배' for vegetables or mushrooms. It is often used at restaurants when talking about fish, mushrooms and wild greens.

examples.en: Bears are omnivores, so they eat both meat and plants.
I eat anything, so there's no food I avoid.
Omnivorous animals adapt easily to their environment.
Pigs are animals that eat both meat and plants.

examples.ko: 책을 잡식으로 읽다 보니 관심 분야가 넓어졌어요.
examples.en: Reading all kinds of books has widened my range of interests.
Humans have a diet close to omnivorous.

explain: 고기도 식물도 다 먹는 식성을 말하고, '육식', '초식'과 짝이에요. 사람이 '나는 잡식이야'라고 하면 음식을 가리지 않는다는 뜻이에요. 책이나 영화를 분야 없이 두루 보는 것도 '잡식'에 빗대어 말해요.
explain_en: It describes a diet of both meat and plants, and pairs with '육식' and '초식'. When a person says '나는 잡식이야', it means they eat anything. People also jokingly use it for reading or watching all kinds of books and films.

examples.ko: 소와 말은 풀을 먹는 초식 동물이에요.
examples.en: Cows and horses are herbivores that eat grass.

examples.ko: 초식 공룡은 대부분 덩치가 크고 이빨이 납작했어요.
examples.en: Most herbivorous dinosaurs were large and had flat teeth.
Rabbits are herbivores, so they don't eat meat.

examples.ko: 동물원에서는 육식 동물과 초식 동물 구역을 나눠서 관리해요.
examples.en: The zoo manages the carnivore and herbivore areas separately.

examples.ko: 초식은 소화 기관이 길어서 풀을 오래 소화해요.
examples.en: Herbivores have long digestive systems, so they digest grass for a long time.

examples.ko: 우리 집 고양이는 육식인데 사촌네 토끼는 초식이에요.
examples.en: Our cat is a carnivore, but my cousin's rabbit is a herbivore.

explain: 주로 '초식 동물', '초식 공룡'처럼 쓰고, 반대말은 '육식'이에요. 풀도 고기도 먹으면 '잡식'이라고 해요.

phrases.example: 그 사람은 연애에 적극적이지 않은 초식남이에요.
phrases.en: He's a herbivore guy who isn't pushy about dating.
phrases.nuance_ko: 풀만 먹는 동물처럼 연애나 경쟁에 소극적이고 온순한 남자를 가리키는 신조어예요. 가볍게 설명하거나 놀리는 말투로 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: A newer slang term for a gentle man who is passive about romance and competition, like a plant-eating animal. It is used in a light, explaining or teasing tone.

explain_en: It is mainly used as in '초식 동물' (herbivore) or '초식 공룡' (herbivorous dinosaur), and the opposite is '육식' (meat-eating). An animal that eats both plants and meat is '잡식' (omnivorous).
